scope: Distinct current-main worktree versus complete reviewed native candidate; no extension of old fixed samples.
baseline: Exact current main project files, including all 35 pending native paths and the admitted P4 repair. Evidence artifacts and explicitly workspace-excluded crates/comparisons are outside the snapshot.
candidate: Exact 17-path reviewed delta, byte-identical to the frozen allocator candidate in runtime/build/test files. Both snapshots carry the same current evidence ledger.
metadata: Separate measurement copies add the same private three-control test helper and counting probe to both variants. Production copies remain uninstrumented.
builds: Separate source/target directories for all four copies. Build all public libraries and 22 probe/test binaries before controls or costs; verify compiler artifacts bind each crate to its own source.
allocator_scope: Public library time/abort/broad probes use System; allocation probes count requested Rust bytes over System. The private metadata wrapper is present in both modes. MiMalloc belongs to the separate native CLI/test crate, not these consumers.
correctness: Every original probe assertion remains and every output/representation/receipt comparison is preserved. Metadata controls run in both copies. Existing frozen qualification evidence remains valid for the same production source; this phase alone is not final qualification or admission.
deferred_application: Original gates, full-report replay and five fixed board/startup pairs will be specified in a separate frozen runner after interpreting library results. No old application sample is extended or pooled.
